name: AudioMixer
subtitle: YouTube + Spotify mixer for iOS
description: AudioMixer lets you play YouTube videos and Spotify music simultaneously with independent volume control, stereo panning, EQ, and a DJ crossfader.

apps.name: AudioMixer
apps.subtitle: YouTube + Spotify, one glorious mix
apps.localizedDescription:
Mix YouTube videos and Spotify music simultaneously. Features:

• Independent volume & stereo pan for each source
• DJ crossfader with equal-power curve
• Spotify search with 30-second previews
• Spotify App Remote for full-track playback
• 4-preset EQ on Spotify channel
• Retro 70s psychedelic UI with glassmorphic design
